name: Private Detective: Obannon's Curse
source:
Three detectives are tasked with finding a serial killer, whom everybody believes to be a vengeful spirit, but those brave enough to help could end up being the killer themselves.

[From [url=https://siraggy.itch.io/private-detective-obannons-curse-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三名侦探的任务是寻找一名连环杀手，每个人都认为他是一个复仇之魂，但那些勇敢提供帮助的人最终可能会成为凶手。

[来自[url=https://siraggy.itch.io/private-detective-obannons-curse-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
